summary: Built the accessible static docs and local-first playground. The docs site covers overview, publisher, consumer, reference, integration, Ecme exploration, governance, FAQ, and troubleshooting, and copies versioned source references deterministically. The no-account playground validates local JSON and restricted YAML, performs privacy and structural checks, generates origin-derived starter profiles, offers local exploration, module coverage, Schema.org preview, signature-shape and conformance-report views, and top-level comparison. Browser and static checks confirm semantic controls, visible focus/skip paths, no remote validation, no raw HTML injection, no upload/retention path, and draft-status language. No hosted runtime service or production deployment is claimed.

commands.cmd: browser smoke: fixture, starter, YAML/privacy interaction
